Plan all 24 Orchard modules. These final values supersede earlier drafts.

Values: billing.max_workers=22; scheduler.timeout_s=50, retry_limit=9; backup.retry_limit=5; auth.retry_limit=3; export.timeout_s=75, retry_limit=7; ledger.retry_limit=6; sync.retry_limit=5; metrics.max_workers=14, batch_size=550; alerts.ttl_s=600; inventory.ttl_s=150; reports.batch_size=900; media.queue_depth=150; profile.queue_depth=340.

Coupling limits (apply given values above): media.timeout_s≥120; alerts.timeout_s≥120; audit.queue_depth≤30; notify.batch_size≥800; sync.ttl_s≥540; gateway.max_workers≥28; webhooks.batch_size≥850; reports.max_workers≥30.

Workers: alpha only: notify, export, profile. Beta only: webhooks, reports, sync, checkout, audit. Co-locate: auth+catalog, export+upload, scheduler+tenant, alerts+media. Separate: catalog/upload, audit/backup, media/upload, audit/scheduler, audit/sync.

Dependencies: billing→sync, quota→billing, archive→billing, profile→sync, shipping→ledger, shipping→checkout, media→scheduler, backup→quota. Forbidden paths (direct or transitive): audit→billing, metrics→billing, backup→webhooks, metrics→alerts.

Order: reports before backup. Rollout: reports before gateway; checkout and webhooks before quota.

Files: worker.py→shipping; retry.py→alerts; loader.py→upload; serial.py→inventory; locks.py→export; types.py, hooks.py→archive; policy.py→billing.

Unspecified details are your call.
